agent.result_text:
I've moved the tier boundaries. STEADY now covers momentum from 0 up to and including 199, SURGE starts at 200, and SINK is still anything below zero. `bin/e2e` passes.

The change is in `getTier()` in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/people/Person.java`, where the STEADY cutoff went from `<= 99` to `<= 199`. I updated the comment above it to match. The tier is only calculated there; the front end just displays it, so nothing else needed changing. The stored data and the test endpoints are unaffected.
